public.name: Marine Layer

campaign.name: Fall 2026 Re-Spun Launch
campaign.goal: Reach 18-34 in SF, LA, NYC and Austin with the Re-Spun story (softest tee, made from old tees). Target CPM <= $25 on delivered views, plus tracked affiliate sales and repostable organic clips.

wanted_deliverables.notes: Product on screen >= 8 seconds, Re-Spun said or shown once
Link sticker with campaign link or code
Optional add-on, cut of the Reel is fine

campaign.target_audience: 18-34, US, primarily San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York City, Austin

public.brand_voice: Warm, a little goofy, never salesy. Short sentences. Obsessed with softness. California as a mood, not a postcard. Everyday weekend clothes worn on weekdays.
content_guidelines: Everyday wear in real places (coffee walk, ferry, Sunday cook); no studio sets
Creator uses their own words about how the fabric feels; no script read
Re-Spun angle is one casual line, not a lecture on textile waste
Product visible at least 8 seconds in the Reel, worn not folded
Tag @marinelayer, use campaign link or code, FTC disclosure (#ad or paid partnership label)
Natural light preferred; music from the platform's licensed library only
no_gos: No political content in the deliverable or caption
No competitor apparel visible in the same Reel
No perpetual usage rights; 90-day paid ads is the ceiling

custom: Invite to SF HQ Re-Spun launch event (Oct 2026)
Feature on @marinelayer Instagram (feed or Stories repost)
Early access to new drops for the season

concession_rules.notes: Open at 55% of per-creator max as a product+cash mix. Each round add up to 12% of max, preferring to add product, store credit or affiliate points before cash. Walk after round 6.

priorities: Authentic everyday wear, creator's own words
SF / California identity visible in the content
Product on screen >= 8 seconds in the Reel
Product-heavy mixes over pure cash (product costs ~40% of retail)
30-day paid ads rights if cheap; not required
walk_away_if: All-in cost (cash + wholesale product + credit at 45%) exceeds 6500 USD
Implied CPM on creator's stated average views exceeds 45 USD after round 4
Creator refuses any affiliate component and demands cash-only above 4000 USD
Creator asks for perpetual usage payment or refuses to disclose per FTC
Creator insists on a discount code above 20% or on fast-fashion comparison content
Creator has visible competitor apparel deals scheduled inside the campaign window without category exclusivity
